FIXED 2026-05-30. Same root cause (10-15s timeouts vs ~30s latency). 0.44 is a GENUINE soft spot (cross-session consistency) — now measurable.

headline: On EVERY suite where generation actually occurred, h-uman scores 0.44-1.00. The two 0.00 suites were a post-hoc-timeout HARNESS bug (now fixed), not capability failures. The automated proxies cannot locate a '5%' gap; the genuine soft spots are tier1_naturalness (0.50) and longitudinal (0.44).
actionable_bug_FIXED: RESOLVED 2026-05-30: eval.c post-hoc timeout discarded non-empty output (recorded as 0.00). Fix: keep slow-but-non-empty output; added pure predicate hu_eval_run_empty_invalid + run->invalid guard + loud warning so >50%-empty runs are flagged INVALID instead of scored 0.00. Full suite 13325/13325; fidelity 0.00->0.72, longitudinal 0.00->0.44.
still_the_only_real_gap: Blind human discrimination vs Seth's real texts. Harness built + verified at scripts/blind_ab/. Every automated number is a proxy; this is the ground truth and the only place a real 'feels off' gap could still hide.
implication: Confidence that the arbitration build is the top lever is now LOW on the evidence. Do the blind human A/B first; let its number decide whether to build arbitration at all.
